title: Make a podcast episode
summary: Reads a script aloud with the system voice and saves it as an episode in the Podcasts library on this device, with a link that plays it.
whenToUse: Use when the person wants to listen rather than read. Write the script first: 250 to 400 words of plain spoken sentences, no headings or Markdown.

arguments.name: script
arguments.description: 250 to 400 words of plain spoken sentences

example: Turn that write-up into a short podcast
